page.content:
Coastal city of mayors, gangs, and Street Fighter 6's hub.

How Metro City connects

  • Work: Street Fighter 6 — Street Fighter 6 uses Metro City as its open hub.
  • Character: Ken Masters — Ken Masters makes his home in Metro City.
  • Character: Luke Sullivan — Luke Sullivan's Street Fighter 6 chapter is set in Metro City.
  • Character: Jamie Siu — Jamie Siu is a Metro City street fighter.

What is Metro City?

Metro City is the American city of Final Fight and later Street Fighter, home to Ken, Luke, and Jamie, and the open-world hub of Street Fighter 6.

Key threads lead to Street Fighter 6, Ken Masters, Luke Sullivan and Jamie Siu.
